BRS Marks 10 Years of Wanaparthy District Formation

The Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) organized a 2K run in Wanaparthy to commemorate the 10th anniversary of the district's formation. As part of the celebrations, party members performed a milk abhishekam (ritualistic pouring of milk) on a portrait of K. Chandrashekar Rao (KCR).
